name: commit
description: /commit asks whether to commit and push, only commit, or commit on a new branch, then splits your changes into Conventional Commits, one per logical group, on the branch you are on. Runs on Haiku 5.5.

language.title: Commit language
language.description: Language of the commit messages, e.g. English or Spanish. Set it to "repo" to follow the language the repository's recent commits use.
